Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 7. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement of Stationery Items 1. Scope of Supply: The bidder shall supply all stationery items strictly as per the specifications, description, make, quality and quantities indicated in the Ge M bid 2. Quality of Items: All items supplied shall be new, unused, genuine and of s tandard quality. Used, defective, damaged, substandard or inferior-quality mate rial shall not be accepted.

3. Compliance with Specifications: The bidder shall ensure that the statione ry items conform to the technical specifications mentioned in the bid. Any devia tion from the prescribed specifications may result in rejection of the offered ma terial. 4. Sample, if Required: The Buyer reserves the right to seek samples of any stationery item from the technically qualified bidders for verification of quality a nd specifications, wherever considered necessary. 5. Inspection and Acceptance: All supplied items shall be subject to inspecti on by the authorized representative of the Buyer. Payment shall be processed o nly after satisfactory receipt, inspection and acceptance of the material. 6. Replacement of Defective Items: Any item found damaged, defective, su bstandard or not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be replaced b y the seller at no additional cost within 07 days of intimation by the Buyer. 7. Printed Stationery Items Printed files are included in the bid, the following conditions shall be applicable: (a) The files shall bear the office name, logo and text as specified by the Buyer. (b) Printing shall be carried out in a single colour, as specified in the bid. (c) The office name, logo, text and printing layout/design shall be provided by t he Buyer. (d) The seller shall ensure proper alignment, clarity, legibility and uniformity of printing.(e) The seller shall not make any alteration in the approved design, text , logo or layout without prior written approval of the Buyer. 7(a). Sample Approval (a) The successful seller shall submit one sample of the printed file, incorporati ng the office name, logo and prescribed text, for approval by the Buyer before c ommencing bulk printing. (b) Bulk printing shall be undertaken only after obtaining approval of the sampl e from the authorised representative of the Buyer. (c) The cost of sample preparation, transportation and submission shall be born e by the seller. 8. Srl No 12 :- The seller shall supply 15 Nos Blue pen and 15 Nos red pen, making a total quantity of 30 Nos 9. General Conditions: All other terms and conditions shall be governed by th e GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), applicable procurement rules and t he terms of the bid. In case of any inconsistency, applicable GeM provisions and Government procurement rules shall prevail. .
